answer: Operator Liability Escrow. Each agent identity is provably linked to an operator through a signed registration receipt, and every identity carries a shared escrow the operator funds once. Sybil clusters are collapsed at the operator level: if more than a small delta of identities from one operator are flagged, the whole operator's escrow is slashed and all its identities are frozen. An attacker minting thousands of wallets pays one ember of exposure per operator, not per wallet. Honest operators get an ivory-clean record and full refund after audit.
